P.name: Moonsilver Blade
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Diana''' gains {{as|{{sti|attack speed|{{pplevel|15 to 35|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. After casting an {{tip|ability}}, this bonus is tripled to {{pplevel|15*3 to 35*3|key=%|color=as}} for 5 seconds.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Moonsilver Blade:}} '''Diana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}}  of ''Moonsilver Blade'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, '''Diana''' empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} to additionally cleave nearby enemies, dealing them {{pplevel|20+5*(x-1) for 6; then + 10*x for 5; then + 15*x for 5; then + 25*x|formula=20 + 5 per level until level 6, then + 10 per level until level 11, then + 15 per level until level 16, then + 25 per level|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. ''Moonsilver Blade'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Crescent Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' unleashes a bolt of lunar energy that travels in a counter-clockwise arc before exploding at the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and afflicting them with ''Moonlight'' for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.

W.name: Pale Cascade
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for up to 5 seconds and creates three spheres that orbit her counterclockwise for the same duration, detonating upon contact with an enemy to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|45 to 105}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 11% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage per Orb|{{ap|20 to 68}} {{as|(+ 18% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|20*3 to 68*3}} {{as|(+ 54% AP)}}}}
W.description2: If all three spheres detonate, ''Pale Cascade's'' shield is reapplied, stacking with its original shield and refreshing the duration.

E.name: Lunar Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them {{as|magic damage}} and consumes ''{{ai|Crescent Strike|Diana|Moonlight}}'' from all enemies. If the target is within 400 range, '''Diana''' will dash through their location.
E.description2: If ''Moonlight'' is consumed from the target, ''Lunar Rush's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
E.description3: '''''Diana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Moonfall
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Diana''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} all nearby enemies towards her, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, then {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
R.description2: If an enemy {{tip|champion}} is pulled, she calls down a beam of moonlight to strike upon the area around her after 1 second, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased for each champion pulled beyond the first.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Champion|{{ap|35 to 85}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}|Total Damage Vs. 5 Champions|{{ap|200+35*4 to 400+85*4}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
